Name: Wild Woods
Author: aparacosm
Description:
[b]Mod Details
[/b] ﻿This is a configurable farm replacement map. By default, it replaces the Forest Farm. Wild Woods features a flowing river in the southeast corner that bisects two areas that will still respawn hardwood stumps daily like the original Forest Farm. Tappable trees line the northern farm surrounding the farm cave. A few small hills break up the sameness of the surrounding land, and dirt pathways flow throughout the farmland. All grass and dirt tiles are tillable, so you can surround yourself with plenty of crops. ﻿In addition to the new terrain features, Some of the surrounding foliage has been changed for a more accessible experience. There is now a clear, open path leading to Grandpa's Shrine for anyone who struggles to weave their farmer underneath the foliage. 
﻿﻿Finally, this mod [b]requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿[/b].

[b]Download Instructions
[/b] ﻿Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿. 
﻿﻿Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.﻿
﻿Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿.﻿
﻿Unzip Content Patcher, DaisyNiko's Tilesheets, and Wild Woods into your game's "Mods" folder.

[b]Compatibility[/b] ﻿
﻿This mod has shown no compatibility issues so far. [I will update this if any compatibility issues are found.]

[b]Credits
[/b] ﻿A huge thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url]﻿ who created the tilesheets and allows modders to utilize the tilesheets in custom maps. An additional huge thank you to all the modders in the Stardew Valley Discord server. I could not have done this without all the assistance I received here. Finally, one last thanks to all my friends who supported me throughout the process of creating my first mod.
